title: 安检、登机与延误
goal: 听懂安检员的指令和登机广播，航班延误或改登机口时会询问。
tips: 听广播只抓关键词：航班号、Gate（登机口）、delayed（延误）、cancelled（取消）、boarding（登机）、final call（最后召集）。
take off 有两个意思：脱下（take off your shoes）和飞机起飞（the plane takes off）。
安检员说 Step forward 是“往前走”，Arms up 是“举起双臂”，Step back 是“退后”。

exchanges.hear: Please put your laptop and liquids in a separate tray.
exchanges.hearZh: 请把笔记本电脑和液体单独放一个托盘。
exchanges.reply: OK. Do I need to take off my shoes?

exchanges.hear: Do you have anything in your pockets?
Is this your bag? I need to check it.
exchanges.hearZh: 这是你的包吗？我需要检查一下。

exchanges.hear: You can't take this bottle of water through.
exchanges.reply: Oh, sorry. I'll throw it away.

exchanges.hear: Your flight has been delayed by two hours.
exchanges.hearZh: 您的航班延误了两个小时。
exchanges.reply: What time will it leave now?

exchanges.hear: Your gate has changed to Gate forty-five.
exchanges.reply: Forty-five? How do I get there?

exchanges.hear: We are now boarding passengers in group three.
exchanges.hearZh: 现在请第三组的旅客登机。
exchanges.reply: Excuse me, is this the flight to Paris?
exchanges.replyZh: 打扰一下，这是飞巴黎的航班吗？

exchanges.hear: Your flight has been cancelled because of the weather.
exchanges.hearZh: 由于天气原因，您的航班取消了。
exchanges.reply: Can you put me on another flight?
exchanges.replyZh: 您能帮我安排别的航班吗？

lines.en: Excuse me, is this the gate for the flight to Paris?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这是飞巴黎的登机口吗？

lines.en: Yes, it is. But the flight is delayed.
Oh no. How long is the delay?
About one hour. The new departure time is eleven forty.
lines.zh: 大约一小时。新的起飞时间是十一点四十。

lines.en: No, it's still Gate twenty-six. Please listen for announcements.
lines.zh: 不会，还是26号登机口。请留意广播。

lines.en: OK. Can I get a meal voucher?
lines.zh: 好的。我能领一张餐券吗？

lines.en: Sorry, meal vouchers are only for delays over three hours.
lines.zh: 抱歉，延误超过三小时才发餐券。
